function.arguments: {"index": 3, "status": "acted", "resolution": "Confirmed strong confounding: treatment arm has 95 severe patients vs 21 in control, and 58 mild vs 332 in control. A raw difference in response rates would be biased. Used stratified analysis by severity, computing treatment effect within each severity group and then averaging them with weights based on control arm distribution. This adjusts for the imbalance and provides a valid estimate of treatment effect."}
function.name: resolve_finding
